verses.gurmukhi: ਸਲਿਲ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਦੇਖੋ ਬੋਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਲਾਹ ਗਹੈ ਕਹੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: salil subhaav dhekho borat na kaasaTeh laeh gahai kahai apano hee pratipaario hai ||

en.bdb: Look at water, the nature of it never drowns wood in it. It regards the wood as his own having brought it up by irrigating it and thus keeps the shame of this relationship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਵਤ ਕਾਸਟ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੈ ਕਾਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jugavat kaasaT ridha(n)tar baisa(n)tareh baisa(n)tar a(n)tar lai kaasaT prajaario hai ||

en.bdb: Wood keeps fire in it latently but taking the wood in itself the fire burns it (wood) to ashes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਰਹਿ ਜਲ ਬੋਰਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਢੈ ਮੋਲ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਗਧ ਕੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਉਟਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: agareh jal bor kaaddai baaddai mol taa ko paavak pradhagadh kai adhik aauTaario hai ||

en.bdb: The wood of Gularia Agalocha (Agar) resurfaces in water after sinking for sometime. This sinking increases the value of the wood. For burning it well in fire, it is boiled in water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਊ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰੁਿਧਰੁ ਚੁਇ ਚੋਆ ਹੋਇ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਅਉਗਨਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੫॥
verses.translit_en: tuoo taa ko ruidhar chui choaa hoi salil mil aauganeh gun maanai biradh beechaario hai ||425||

en.bdb: Then its essence mixes well in water to smell sweet. To extract the essence of wood, the water has to bear the hot fire. But its calm and tolerant nature changes its demerits into merits and thus fulfils its duties abiding by its creed. (425)
